smell: VideoProbe metadata fields are optional bare S.Finite values even though the decoded video domain is narrower: duration is non-negative finite seconds, fps is positive, frameCount is a non-negative integer, and dimensions are positive integer pixels.
proposedTarget: Reuse PositiveFrameRate for fps and add named schemas such as NonNegativeSeconds = S.Finite.check(S.isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0)), FrameCount = S.Int.check(S.isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0)), and VideoDimension = S.Int.check(S.isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1)); S.Int/S.Finite and the numeric checks are verified at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:11398, :11380, and :7314. The existing PositiveFrameRate pattern at FFmpeg.models.ts:30-56 is the local exemplar.

smell: Generated frame indexes and counts are modeled as bare S.Finite across ExtractedFrame.index, ExtractFramesManifestSummary.frameCount, ExtractFramesResult.frameCount, FFmpegProgressEvent.frameCount, FFmpegCompletedEvent.frameCount, PlannedFrameCommit.index, TempFrame.index, and ExtractContext.expectedFrameCount, but the service only constructs non-negative integer positions/counts.
proposedTarget: Introduce FrameIndex and FrameCount named schemas with S.Int.check(S.isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0)) and reuse them across the public models plus the internal planning schemas; the existing PositiveFrameRate/PositiveMilliseconds named numeric schemas in FFmpeg.models.ts:30 and :89 are the package-local pattern.

smell: Progress percent is S.Finite even though parseProgressEvent clamps every emitted value into the closed 0-100 range.
proposedTarget: Replace the field with a named Percent schema, e.g. S.Finite.check(S.isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0), S.isLessThanOrEqualTo(100)); S.isLessThanOrEqualTo is verified at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:7370, and the value is already clamped at FFmpeg.service.ts:437.

smell: Process exit codes are modeled as optional or internal bare S.Finite values, but the process domain is integer exit status data rather than arbitrary finite numbers.
proposedTarget: Add a ProcessExitCode schema using S.Int.check(S.isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0)) and reuse it in FFmpegErrorContext.exitCode, FFmpegErrorFromUnknownOptions.exitCode, FFmpegError.exitCode, and ProcessResult.exitCode; this mirrors the local named-number pattern at FFmpeg.models.ts:30 and :89 without changing the encoded shape.

smell: The ffprobe boundary model decodes height/width as bare S.Finite, then VideoProbe preserves them as bare finite values, even though stream dimensions are positive integer pixel counts.
proposedTarget: Decode both boundary and public fields through the same VideoDimension schema, S.Int.check(S.isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1)), so malformed fractional/negative dimensions fail at the boundary before probeFromOutput constructs VideoProbe.
